name: agent-security-skills
description: Security skills for coding agents: a scanner-backed code review with proof tests, a gap analysis against OWASP ASVS, AISVS and MASVS with file:line evidence, a bounded runtime test (DAST) of a disposable local copy, and Claude Code hooks that ask before an agent adds a suppression marker, removes assertions or skips tests, and look up new package names on the public registry (never for a private one); a hook that fails lets the call run and says so.
